items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: I can't remember... But what's Charlie's last name, I don't know. But he's dead now.

ctx.x: I can't remember. No, I think he always used a string bass. A string bass. I'm trying to think of the playing bass with him. I know Chester Lissart played with him for a while. And, uh, Charlie was playing the banjo. But what's Charlie's last name, I don't know. But he's dead now.
Is that Blind Charlie or something? No, no, I know Blind Charlie. I don't know if there was a Charlie Moore up or what? Yeah, I think it really was Charlie Moore.
He used to play with him. He left, he couldn't play any band, he started playing guitar.
